body.x: Hisshow( www.hisshow.co.kr) will showcase Christianity smart content, 'Hisshow Bible' at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show in Las vegas, U.S. held from January 7th to 10th.

'Hisshow Bible' is a character animation which is modernistically dramatized version of characters and episodes in Bible. It enables existing animations and education programs available on smart devices. It consists of animation DVD, workbook and school program, having Spanish as well as English version to launch overseas.

"It is our second time attending the show. We will unveil the finished product to several buyers who show their interest in the products(English/Spanish version), so we expect to discuss the publishment in North&South America"said the officials.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases more than 3,200 exhibitors, including manufacturers, developers and suppliers of consumer technology hardware, content, technology delivery systems and more; a conference and more than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries. The first CES took place in New York City in June of 1967. Since then, thousands of products have been announced at the yearly show in January.
